notes.title: Ver1.0.1　Update
notes.content:
Update Details
-A “turn around” function has been implemented to allow players to look behind them as they move.
-Fixed a problem in which the mouse cursor is displayed in the center of the screen after the message UI is displayed when using a controller.
-Fixed a problem that the mouse cursor was displayed in the center of the screen after the message UI was displayed when using a controller.
-Fixed a problem in which the distance to some “points to check” is adjusted to make them easier to find.
